summary: Wästbygg Gruppen AB (publ) operates as a construction and project development company in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland. It operates through three segments: Residential, Commercial, and Logistics and Industry. The company develops and constructs rental and tenant-owned apartments. In addition, it builds and develops residential, commercial buildings, and community service properties; and logistics and industrial plants under the Logistic Contractor brand name. Further, the company serves municipalities, the state and regions, as well as real estate companies. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Gothenburg, Sweden. Wästbygg Gruppen AB (publ) is a subsidiary of M2 Holding AB.
